title: Spider Is Back
desc: An affluent tycoon, Xiang, coerces Sima Cong to locate the Golden Spider City. Therefore, he visits an island with Lisa and his parent.

title: Rathnam
desc: Rathnam, a henchman for MLA Panner Selvam, rescues a girl from attackers during her interview trip to Vellore. As he becomes her protector, he wonders how long he can keep her safe.

title: Saamy 2
desc: Ramaswamy, who works as a front-end receptionist for Union Minister Viswanathan, decides to pursue civil service. Soon, Viswanathan's daughter falls in love with him after he saves her from gangsters.

title: Baaghi 4
desc: Following a failed suicide attempt, a man struggles with reality and descends into turmoil. His family faces uncertainty while a concealed truth lures him into a complex maze of obsession and love.

title: Kalki 2898 AD
desc: In a post-apocalyptic world, a group of people set out to save a woman pregnant with Lord Vishnu's 10th and final avatar, Kalki, from an evil supreme god-king, Yaskin.

title: Tu Meri Main Tera Main Tera Tu Meri
desc: Star-crossed lovers connect, only to be torn apart by familial obligations. They part ways reluctantly, clinging to the dream of a future reunion.

title: Satyamev Jayate
desc: DCP Shivansh is given a case to arrest the man responsible for the deaths of corrupt police officers. Furthermore, he begins his search and is taken aback upon learning who the killer is.

title: MP3: Mera Pehla Pehla Pyaar
desc: Rumours create friction between Rohan and Ayesha, leading them to separate. However, both quickly realise their error and work to reconcile their relationship.

title: Ghajini
desc: Suffering from memory loss every 15 minutes, a heartbroken man uses photographs, notes and tattoos to keep reminding himself to punish his lady-love's murderer.

title: Bharat
desc: During the independent nation of India, a family gets torn apart, leaving an eight-year-old boy who makes a promise to his father to keep the family together.

title: Hotel Mumbai
desc: A hotel staff risks everything to keep its patrons safe during a terror attack, especially a British heiress, her husband and her infant.

title: Supreme Khiladi
desc: A charitable trust faces threats from a powerful mafia leader who has set his eyes on its land. He plans to kill the legal heir to grab the wealth, but a brave taxi driver becomes an impediment.

title: Ramaiya Vastavaiya
desc: A man is challenged to work in a field and produce a huge harvest by the end of the season in order to marry the love of his life.

title: Koyla
desc: Silenced by a piece of smouldering coal in childhood, Shankar endures a life of slavery until love compels him to seek his voice, freedom, and long-overdue revenge.

title: Wanted
desc: A sharpshooter is caught between a gangster who wants him dead since he knows too much, the police who want him for the information he holds and his girlfriend who yearns for him to mend his ways.

title: Lingaa
desc: Lingaa, a petty thief, turns over a new leaf after realising the role his grandfather has played in building a dam for the villagers. He then dedicates his life to saving it from a corrupt minister.
